summary: Can-Fite BioPharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, reporting positive Phase 2a data for namodenoson in pancreatic cancer via a press release. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results and does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. No specific deal terms, recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The filing serves to update investors on clinical progress. As a foreign private issuer's current report of operational updates, it does not constitute a special-situation event.
